## 席位意见(增量 1 · 列表「新建」入口:spec 默认值与渲染器不一致)· director seat (summon #45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i`), read as batch #374 item 1, 2026-10-20T00:05Z

On the triage seat's decision card, filed on objectstack-ai/objectui#13099's request (B recommended by the filer with C as a fallback; under the maintainer's rule #24444 this delta names one option and no fallback). Opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6279597228. Presented, not self-ruled: every letter moves a published, authorable key (`AddRecordConfigSchema` on views and pages), which is the decision box's floor (`triage-duties.md` L40; 代裁人工地板 「协议/公开契约变化」).

**Premises re-run in this act — objectstack `origin/main` `043100210467`, objectui `origin/main` `90518cdb841a`:**
1. `view.zod.ts:1782–1790`: `enabled` `.default(true)`, `position` `.default('bottom')`, `mode` `.default('inline')`, `formView` optional, on a `strictObject`; the same schema is the page `list-view` node's `addRecord` (`page.zod.ts:1060`); `view.form.ts:178` and `page.form.ts:165` offer it to Studio. Holds.
2. objectui `ListView.tsx:1688–1689` and `:717`: Add draws only on `enabled === true`; an absent `position` maps to top; no reader of `mode` or `formView` anywhere under `packages/**` except a type-alignment test asserting the default. Holds.
3. Producers: showcase `active-projects.page.ts:36` and `contact.view.ts:60` (both `mode: 'form'`; `formView` 'default' and 'create'), one lint fixture; hotcrm and cloud 0 by the card (unreachable from here). Holds.
4. **Not on the card — the create-form capability behind `formView`.** `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx:88` promises 「The binding is `addRecord.mode: 'form'` + `addRecord.formView: 'create'` … No `formViews.create` → the create entry derives a default. Present → it wins for create.」 The showcase `contact.view.ts` authors a sparse `formViews.create` on that promise. objectui's create entry (`app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:218`) reads `objectDef.form ?? objectDef.formViews?.default` and never `formViews.create` nor `addRecord.formView`. So the documented create-vs-edit model is declared in three places (spec key, docs page, showcase) and enforced nowhere: the showcase's create form is never shown. Holds — and it widens the card: B as written retires the selector and leaves the docs page and the showcase form pointing at nothing.
5. ADR-0050 (**Proposed**, not accepted, so not binding) Decision 2 and its 「Non-goals」 reuse `addRecord.mode` as the add-record open-mode carrier; retiring `mode` takes a dated note there (「ADR 条目被协议取代 ⇒ 条目下加带日期注记点名 spec 符号」), Tier H. The mechanical pass named ADR-0076 D12 (advertise only what is mounted); ADR-0049 is the route. Neither picks a letter.

**Facets, this seat's reading against the card's:** ① not a tie, as the card has it: in two years a list's Add is 「shown when the author says so, at the top, opening the object's create form」 — Salesforce and Airtable interfaces both put New at the top and open a form; WHICH form is a per-object convention (`formViews.create` when present, else the default form), not a per-list selector; HOW it opens is the list's existing `navigation.mode` if ever needed, not a second enum. Two keys leave, none arrives, and the documented create-vs-edit model becomes true with one selection line. ② in-repo pull: two showcase rows, both already 「form」; the one real authored intent (`formView: 'create'` on `contact`) is honoured by convention, not by the key. ③ `addRecord: {}` today draws nothing and says nothing; with `enabled` REQUIRED (no default) it is refused at authoring and publish instead of parked silently — 响亮拒绝优于静默容忍; the retired keys answer with the ADR-0087 notice. ④ a deletion of two keys plus one line of convention; A and C build renderer features nobody authored (inline add; modal and named-form plumbing).

**Recommend B′ — B, with `enabled` required and the create form chosen by convention.** 口径: `AddRecordConfigSchema` keeps `enabled` (required, no default) and `position` (default `top`; `top` / `bottom` / `both` as the renderer draws them); `mode` and `formView` retire through the `spec-property-retirement` kit with ADR-0087 conversions that drop them with a notice; the showcase's two rows and the lint fixture lose the two keys; objectui's create entry selects `formViews.create` when the object declares it, else today's `form` / `formViews.default` (one line in `recordFormNavigation.ts`, pinned); `create-vs-edit-form.mdx:88` states the convention and names no binding; ADR-0050 Decision 2 gains a dated note that the list add-record open mode is no longer declared. Not taken: A (builds inline add and moves every button to the bottom for a default nobody wrote); B as written (leaves the docs recipe and the showcase create form pointing at a retired key); C (plumbs `mode` and `formView` through the renderer for zero authored demand).

**Workload of the letter:** `domain:spec` · 1 PR, S–M (schema, two conversions, the two form composites, regenerated artifacts, showcase and fixture edits; `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, breaking, with its ADR-0087 disposition and FROM → TO) · objectui `domain:ui` · 1 PR, S (one selection line plus pin; objectstack-ai/objectui#13099 becomes that card) · `domain:devx` · 1 docs PR, S · ADR-0050 note, Tier H, S (may ride the spec PR as its governed half). Precedent: the ADR-0049 retirements of `view-strictness-batch18.test.ts`. Timing as the card says: not before 18.0 GA.

**After the ruling:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:spec`, p3); the spec seat dispatches with the kit; objectstack-ai/objectui#13099 leaves `pm:blocked` for the one-line selection card with the ruled convention quoted; a `domain:devx` docs card follows the spec landing.

Ruling: batch #374 item 1 · letter B′ · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-20T02:21Z

Director seat, summon #45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i` (GitHub `os-justin`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay, read back), on the triage seat's decision card filed on objectstack-ai/objectui#13099's request (B recommended by the filer; this seat's delta 6280103693 recommended B′). Opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6279597228; ledger block B 6280112485. The maintainer's words in this session's chat, in order: 「没听懂，要不简单画个图」, answered with the three-figure diagram https://claude.ai/artifact/Ummx2sxuuzusTCr6yzFviR (today, the four letters, B′ after), then 「同意」. Thread-read: 6280103693.

**What the ruling binds (letter B′ — B, with `enabled` required and the create form chosen by convention):**
1. `AddRecordConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the same schema on the page `list-view` node) keeps two keys: `enabled`, REQUIRED with no default, so `addRecord: {}` is refused at authoring and at publish instead of drawing nothing; and `position`, default `top`, values `top` / `bottom` / `both` as the renderer draws them.
2. `mode` and `formView` retire through the `spec-property-retirement` kit: ADR-0087 conversion entries that drop the two keys from authored and stored bodies with a notice, `retiredKey()` tombstones on the strict object, the two form composites (`view.form.ts:178`, `page.form.ts:165`), regenerated artifacts, the liveness ledger. `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, breaking, with its ADR-0087 disposition and the FROM → TO in the changeset.
3. The producers follow in the same PR: showcase `active-projects.page.ts:36`, `contact.view.ts:60` and the lint fixture `showcase-shape.fixtures.ts:414` lose `mode` / `formView`; `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx:88` states the convention of item 4 and names no binding — the docs line is part of the retirement kit's surface and is declared in the claim as a cross-domain file.
4. objectui: the create entry selects `formViews.create` when the object declares it, else today's `form` / `formViews.default` (`app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:218`, one selection line, pinned by a test). objectstack-ai/objectui#13099 is that card; its parity row (`p1-spec-alignment.test.ts:189`, the `mode` default) changes when objectui's pin takes the spec release.
5. ADR-0050 (Proposed) Decision 2 gains a dated note that the list add-record open mode is no longer declared on `addRecord`; how the create form opens stays the renderer's, and a per-list open mode, if ever wanted, is the list's existing `navigation.mode`, never a second enum. Tier H; it may ride the spec PR (the PR is then Tier H whole) or go as its own one-line PR — the spec seat chooses.
6. Timing as the card says: not before 18.0 GA.
Not taken: A (inline add and a bottom button for a default nobody wrote), B as written (the docs recipe and the showcase create form left pointing at a retired key), C (`mode` / `formView` plumbed through the renderer for zero authored demand).

**Workload of the letter:** `domain:spec` · 1 PR, S–M (precedent: the ADR-0049 retirements of `view-strictness-batch18.test.ts`) · objectui `domain:ui` · 1 PR, S (objectstack-ai/objectui#13099) · ADR-0050 note, S.

**Execution:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:spec`, `priority:p3`); the spec seat dispatches with the kit and quotes items 1–5 in the PR body; objectstack-ai/objectui#13099 moves `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` in this act with the ruled convention quoted — the selection line does not wait on the spec PR.
